description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Thought Lash's cumulative upkeep ability triggers; decline to pay the cost and sacrifice Thought Lash.
Thought Lash's second ability triggers, causing you to exile all cards from your library.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one and shuffling Nexus of Fate into your empty library.
Draw Nexus of Fate on your next draw step.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.
